name: Psychotic Containment Facility
desc:
You’ve been assigned here—await your evaluation and prepare for what lies ahead.

⚠️ Important Information

- Contains loud noises and disturbing imagery—play at your own discretion.

- Gameplay is combat and violence-focused. While designed for PC, it offers partial support on other platforms.


Controls: Use Left Alt or Right Shift for Shiftlock. C for knee kick, V to stomp, G to choke, H to headbutt, F to dodge

This title is a direct continuation of The Mental Hospital.

Roleplay is semi-serious: staff roles follow stricter RP rules, while patients experience a lighter version
